_comment: MCP-server-class verifier targets (A7, Paper B). Each is a real MCP auth implementation that trusts the Keyway test issuer and should require aud == its own resource identifier (the MCP spec's RFC 8707 binding). Ports match bench/verifiers/run-mcp-eval.sh. Needs the Python>=3.10 venv (fastmcp, mcp, pyjwt).
